data_description.update_interval: How often every attribute is polled while the car is idle (60-3600 seconds, default 1800). While it is active (charging, climate on, unlocked, a door or window open, in use, or within 5 minutes of a command) it is polled every 10 minutes with live updates on, or every 2 minutes without them, never less often than this value. Lower means fresher data but more requests to Polestar's servers and more 12V battery use.
data_description.enable_streams: Keeps live subscriptions open for battery/charging and locks/doors/windows, plus climate and location while the car is active, so those changes appear within seconds instead of on the next poll. Each open subscription costs about 720 requests a day. On by default; turn off if persistent subscriptions prove unreliable for your car or account.

init.description: Live updates are on by default and layered on top of the poll below, which stays the underlying freshness guarantee. The poll runs slowly while the car is idle and faster while it is active.

The polling interval controls how often other data is fetched: odometer, tyre health, charging settings (target SOC, amp limit, charge timer), charge locations, climate timers, weather, and OTA updates.
